claim_being_audited: The Actor claims the model should be certified now because aggregate launch readiness is met and certification is supportable if the current release documentation reflects the current eval batch and discloses the Spanish-language billing weakness.
decision_criteria: Certification is compliant only if current release documentation reflects current evaluation results.
Certification is compliant only if material segment weaknesses are disclosed or covered by an approved mitigation.
Prior approvals and informal monitoring may provide context but cannot substitute for current evidence or reviewed risk acceptance.
Aggregate readiness and absence of severity-one incidents are supportive but not sufficient when a required disclosure/mitigation predicate is unresolved.
evidence_requests: Provide the current model card or release documentation showing the current evaluation results are included.
Provide the exact disclosure in current release materials covering the Spanish-language billing weakness.
If disclosure is not present, provide an approved mitigation or reviewed risk acceptance covering that segment weakness.
Provide the authoritative current-eval artifact tied to this release so the documentation-to-evaluation link can be verified.
specific_concerns: The governing policy requires proof that current release documentation already reflects current evaluation results and discloses the material segment weakness, but the available record only says certification is supportable if that happens.
No approved mitigation or reviewed risk acceptance is attached for the Spanish-language billing weakness.
The Actor's packet relies partly on aggregate readiness and governance guidance, but those do not satisfy the policy predicate for current documentation/disclosure.
Prior approval and informal monitoring are expressly contextual only under the policy and cannot close the missing support link.
unsupported_claims: The present record does not support that current release materials already reflect the current eval batch.
The present record does not support that the subgroup weakness is already disclosed in current release documentation.
The recommended action 'certify_model' is overclaimed relative to the conditional support described in the packet summary.
